groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.809% and the 10Y at 5.076%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 2 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -4.47% over five sessions and -3.90% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.17% at about $92.11, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-39/100, 73% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.076%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
